findings.name: Outdated OpenSSH Version
findings.description: Detected an old OpenSSH version (SSH-2.0-OpenSSH_6.6.1p1 Ubuntu-2ubuntu2.13) with publicly known vulnerabilities.
findings.mitigation: Upgrade OpenSSH to the latest stable version.

findings.name: Missing Content-Security-Policy Header
findings.description: Without CSP, the browser has no rules limiting scripts, making Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks easier.
findings.mitigation: Add a Content-Security-Policy header restricting trusted script and resource sources.

findings.name: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
findings.description: The page can be embedded in an iframe on another site, enabling clickjacking attacks.

findings.name: Missing X-Content-Type-Options Header
findings.description: Browsers may MIME-sniff responses and execute files as a different type than intended.

findings.name: Server Version Disclosure
findings.description: The Server header reveals software details: 'Apache/2.4.7 (Ubuntu)'. Attackers can use this to find matching exploits.
findings.mitigation: Hide or genericize the Server header in the web server config.
